argv: How many charging bays should we provision for a two-shift operation?

parsed.answer: For a two-shift operation, Acme recommends provisioning one bay for every two robots [sample_corpus/product-specs.md:Acme Robotics — Product Specifications > Dockyard-2 Charging Station > Capacity and Footprint]. If you follow this ratio but still see robots queueing at docks, the likely cause is an auto-return threshold set too high — robots returning at 40% state of charge create artificial contention [sample_corpus/faq.md:Frequently Asked Questions > Fleet Operations > How many charging bays do we need?].
